data.Name: Ominous Prophecy
data.Description: A fortune teller draped in seventeen scarves blocks your path. Their crystal ball is clearly a snow globe from a gift shop. 'I SEE YOUR FUTURE!' they announce dramatically, knocking over their folding table. 'It is... VAGUE AND OMINOUS!'
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "none", "text": "The fortune teller squints into the snow globe. 'I see... bread. Lots of bread. A sandwich perhaps? No wait, that's my lunch reflection.' Nothing happens. The prophecy was about lunch.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "spawn_enemy", "text": "'I see DANGER! Right behind you! The fortune teller packs up and runs.", "params": {"deck": "beta_enemy_deck.json", "count": 1}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "heal_player", "text": "'The stars say you will feel better very soon!'
